title: Air at a focus: rotational Raman, ionisation and pulse retrieval
summary: A 0.4 mJ, 40 fs pulse at 800 nm focused (w0 = 100 µm) in the middle of 1 m of air gains B = 6.65 rad, loses 8.8 % of its energy to photo-ionisation and shifts its spectral centroid from 800 nm to 815 nm; a simulated SHG-FROG of the output retrieves a 50.3 fs pulse (51.3 fs simulated).
